summary: Tested the report scope isolation in server.py (_report_scope_guard and the 9 changed report endpoints) and select_teachers in teacher_overtime.py. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass, all read-only GETs. Saeed (department_head, كلية البنات) now gets 403 on the Sharia student, teacher-summary (also its PDF export), course detailed (also its PDF export) and department report. He gets empty lists for teacher-workload?faculty_id=Sharia, teacher-workload/raised, teacher-delays?department_id=Sharia and teacher-attendance?department_id=Sharia. Workload with no filter returns 3 teachers for Saeed and 15 for admin. With department_id=Sharia, the list reports (absent-students, warnings, daily, attendance-overview, lesson-completion) return no Sharia data for Saeed. With no filter, Saeed still sees his own scope (attendance-overview 4 courses, lesson-completion 4, teacher-attendance 5 teachers, own department report 200). Admin is unrestricted everywhere (attendance-overview 34 courses, teacher-attendance 7 teachers). Salim (dean of Sharia) still gets 200 on the Sharia student, teacher and course. Teacher regressions pass: 222222 summary and workload 200 with 1 teacher; teacher180156 absent-students 200. A DB integrity snapshot (md5 of role/permission/scope/password/real_enforcement fields for users, roles and advanced_access_testers) was identical before and after. Frontend as admin: report-student, report-teacher-workload, availability-report, report-teacher-summary, report-course, report-teacher-attendance, report-attendance-overview and report-warnings all render with no 4xx/5xx API calls. The overtime raise-letter modal still shows the 'من يشمله هذا الخطاب؟' box with 4 teacher checkboxes and the toggle-all; toggling works. The letter was NOT actually raised.

minor.issue: The two reports scope teachers differently. teacher-summary uses the 'teachers' scope (the teacher's own department_id), while teacher-attendance and teacher-delays use course scope. Saeed sees 5 teachers in teacher-attendance but only 3 in workload, so a teacher who teaches in his department but belongs to another department appears in attendance and then gets 403 on teacher-summary. Not a leak; just inconsistent UX.

The scope check requires at least one course in the department (db.courses.find_one with dept_id plus own_scope). A dean or department head opening a department in their own scope that has no courses gets 403 instead of an empty report. Checking the 'departments' scope against the departments collection would be more accurate.

issues: The top header bar shows the raw route name 'availability-report' instead of an Arabic title (existed before this change).

action_items: Optional: in routes/overtime_letter.py, rebuild_overtime_table (called from letters.py lines 644 and 744 when a draft is edited) now goes through select_teachers with the EDITOR's scope. If a scoped user (e.g. a dean) edits an overtime draft that a broader-scope user (admin) created for a wider scope, the regenerated table is silently narrowed to the editor's scope. Consider rebuilding with the creator's scope, or keeping the original teachers_list.
Optional: make the department report scope check use the departments scope instead of requiring an existing course.
Optional: align teacher-summary scope with course-based scope, or accept the difference.
critical_code_review_comments: _report_scope_guard is a clean wrapper and correctly skips users with advanced_access_real_enforcement (they have their own guard).

The PDF and Excel export endpoints (teacher-summary/export-pdf, course/{id}/export-pdf, teacher-delays/export, teacher-attendance export, warnings export) call the guarded functions internally, so they inherit the isolation. The two PDF exports were verified with 403 for Saeed.

All callers of select_teachers were checked: server.py teacher-workload, teacher_overtime.py exports (797, 811), and overtime_letter.py raised (146), rebuild (197) and raise (227). They are consistent apart from the rebuild_overtime_table concern above.
Existing issue: in the get_course_detailed_report TEACHER branch, the teacher is resolved only by teachers.user_id, not by the unified resolve_teacher_ids.
server.py is more than 20K lines and should be split.
seed_data_creation: None. Only GET requests were made; no letters were raised and no users, roles or permissions were changed (verified by DB hash).
